title: Consumer
claims: The page describes Consumer Insurance Search as a way to find information about insurance company complaints, licenses, and financial health.
The page describes the Life Insurance Policy Locator as a free tool that helps beneficiaries search for unclaimed life insurance policies.

The page also lists a Glossary of Insurance Terms, How to File a Complaint, a Consumer Participation Program, Learning Resources, an Online Fraud Reporting System, and the Global Receivership Information Database.
The page publishes no NAIC telephone number and routes consumers who want to file a complaint to their own state insurance department through a state selector.
